**Verdict: technically clean and ready; the body needs before/after screenshots before `/merge-ready` offers this PR.**

## What looks good
- `ground_grid_lines` now reads `show_grid` alone (`crates/ui/src/interact.rs:857`). The grid is fully decoupled from `show_world_axes`: the only other draw gate on the axes is the triad path (`interact.rs:512`), and the overlay caller (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/world.rs:370`) adds no second condition.
- The pinning tests cover both directions the issue asked for: axes off leaves the grid, grid off hides it, axes on does not bring it back (`crates/ui/src/law_tests.rs:75-81`), and the Display-menu test asserts the field and the drawn lines together (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/display_menu.rs:89-90`).
- Hover texts and the two doc comments now match the behaviour (`display_menu.rs:110,113`, `interact.rs:852-854`, `state.rs:1816`).
- The readings line is correct: `show_grid` is the only key persisted in the view file (`state_view.rs:36,66`); `show_world_axes` is not saved, so saved preferences are unchanged. (Issue #3322 says "the saved view preferences keep both keys" - the code keeps only `show_grid`; the PR body is right.)
- Law check: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` on the touched paths; no new direct writes to document state (view prefs stay as before); tests sit in the crate they test; no new crate dependencies; no process files, goldens, or snapshot PNGs touched; conventional commit subject, `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #3322`.

## Results
- Built merged with `main` (`17458411`): automatic trial merge, no conflicts.
- On the self-hosted runner ([run 45012310050](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45012310050)), conclusion `success`, on the merged tree:
  - Quick gate: 19 steps, 0 failed. The `camcraft-ui` lib suite: 1424 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored - this includes all 40 `structural` tests, all `page_layout` tests (the affected `layout_window_display_menu` among them), and both new pinning tests. The 18 other ui suites all passed.
  - Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean (the author's gate had not run it).
- The diff has no OS-specific code, so no separate Windows arm was owed.

## Heavy lanes
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` locally: the diff reaches no heavy lane. Nothing to run.

## Requested before merge
1. Before/after screenshots in the PR body. This change is visible in the viewport: with "Origin axes" off and "Grid" on, the grid must now stay. Standing order for UI PRs: add one screenshot of the viewport with the axes hidden and the grid on (before: grid gone, after: grid drawn), or an equivalent pair, to the body before `/merge-ready` offers the PR. This does not change the technical verdict above.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Issue #3322's Done-means line asks for the switch pair "from each of the three switches" (Display box, Browser box, viewport nav button). The Browser box and the nav button write the same field as the Display box (`browser_pane.rs:129`, `viewport_bar.rs:219`), so the field behaviour is covered; a per-switch test is still open. If you want it, a small `P7` follow-up issue is the right shape.
- The body reports 1425 lib tests; the merged tree on the runner reports 1424 + 7 ignored. Same suite, main moved between the two runs - no action.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
